system.summary: French numerical nomenclator of about 1-800, mixed (no alphabetical order): letters (404 s, 505 r, 10 l, 30 e, 604 n, 785 t), syllables (734 ti, 347 on, 301 re, 333 te, 744 ment, 232 tion) and words (600 de, 72 la, 25 le/les, 575 pour, 233 colonie, 642 artillerie, 134 Monseigneur, 149 isle, 798 Cayenne); word endings often not enciphered (297 nécessaire/nécessité); clear words interspersed. Same code in 1779 and 1780; not the Guiana code of 1757-62.
system.notes: 448 distinct numbers in f9 + f16 (6,832 groups). A few homophones are probable (558/140 établis). Spearman rho on the sure values: 0.23 (1-400), -0.07 (401-800): no order found.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of the time found in C14 51 (376 views surveyed) or C14 52 (338 views); catalogue 1201 vetting (3 Nov 2026): no DECODE record, nothing on cryptiana, Lasry or HistoCrypt, no edition. The minister's answers (ANOM series B) were not seen.

solution.what: f9 and f16 transcribed group by group (6,833 groups) and frozen; held-out portion fixed (f9 postscript, f16 last 5 lines).
Guiana 1757-62 key and Bouillé's Martinique codes (B: K1, K6, K8; minister's code M of 1777) tested against 200 permuted keys: none applies.
Cribs from clear headings of neighbouring pieces: 183.633.600.72.233 = défense de la colonie; 90 = en, 600 = de, 25 = les ...; about 20% of the groups.

Two pairs of the time found and aligned: C14 51 ff. 102-111 with its clear copy ff. 98-101, and C14 52 ff. 15-16 (29 Apr 1780) with its 'Déchiffrement' ff. 17-19v; keys K-Guy1780 (296) and K-Guy1780b (401 values) frozen.

K-Guy1780 on held-out V1 (end of f102): characters 0.758, words 0.647 vs controls 0.105 / 0.145; K-Guy1780b on held-out V2 (end of the 1780 pair): 0.805 / 0.707 vs 0.291 / 0.166; thresholds 0.85 / 0.75 not met. A third measurement on a paraphrase was null. Applicability on f9/f16: rank 1/201.

Claude Fable 5.2 (one API run, held-out portion removed from the copies sent) proposed K-Guy1780c = K-Guy1780b plus corrections and context restorations (454 entries, each with a status); frozen at 14:07 CET.

One pre-registered measurement on the held-out portion (118 groups): strict lexical reading S = 0.703 vs max 0.576 (200 permuted keys) and 0.644 (200 length-shuffled keys), rank 1/401, threshold 0.656 calibrated on training windows -> pass; limits: 118 groups (< 150), margin +0.059, lexical reference, held-out groups displayed (not decoded) by a diff after the freeze.

f9 and f16 read word by word (segmentation checked by script against the frozen transcription): f9 754 words 508 S + 159 P = 88.5%; f16 2,650 words 1,876 S + 477 P = 88.8%; 309 restored and 75 unresolved not counted. 398 = 'ils' contradicted three times (reads 'ap').

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key aligned on two pairs of the time in the same series (a cipher letter of 1779 with its clear copy, and a cipher of 1780 with its decipherment), then extended by Claude Fable 5.2 from the context of f9/f16, frozen, and measured once on a portion of f9/f16 held out since 28 Oct 2026.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md / words_f09.tsv / words_f16.tsv: certain + probable words over all cipher words of both letters, (667 + 2,353) / (754 + 2,650) = 3,020/3,404 = 88.7% (f9 88.5%, f16 88.8%); 309 restored and 75 unresolved not counted. Stricter count (words probable only because the encipherer left out or doubled a letter put with the restored): f9 85.4%, f16 86.7%.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py), protocol SHA-256 4307c904b9ff65c6b03d608161b327115f2810bcf9cde334be498578544aa442 hashed before the run: strict lexical reading S = 0.703 vs max 0.576 (200 permuted keys) / 0.644 (200 length-shuffled keys), rank 1/401, theta 0.656 calibrated on training only -> passed its rule. Recorded as weak: 118 groups (our rule asks 300 cipher characters or 150 groups; only the first met), margin +0.059 over the best control, lexical reference (no clear of the time), held-out groups displayed (not decoded) by a diff after the key freeze; the earlier key K-Guy1780b failed two held-out tests against clears of the time (0.758 and 0.805 < 0.85).

texts.label: f9, Fiedmond to the minister, Cayenne 19 July 1779, 'Approvisionnement et troupes', with postscript
texts.summary: The convoy under the King's corvette l'Hirondelle has arrived with troops, victuals and munitions, but the Court's orders were carried out imperfectly (cartridge-pouches forgotten); the repair of the works stopped since 1771 by the abbé Terray; no bomb-proof powder magazine; arsenal and port without workmen, timber or sailors; one gunboat sent instead of two and two bad apprentices instead of six good carpenters; gunboats like the one built in 1772 are best; La Serre given the coast service, Desprez and Mingy; the artillery company to be raised by 33 men. Postscript: ships bound for the colony should make a recognition signal off the island.

reading_review.by: Claude Opus 5.5 agent for Brice Dudout

AI agents only; no human read the reading; not re-checked on the images.

texts.label: f16, Fiedmond to the minister, Cayenne 29 August 1779, 'Deffence de la colonie'
texts.summary: Report under ten heads on the defence of Cayenne island: gunboats and carpenters, the powder magazine, artillery and the gunners, the new recruits (drunkenness, desertion), a critique of the defence memoir of 'the author worthy of Monseigneur's confidence', the impossibility of guarding every cove (Remontabo, Remire, Mahury) with the troops at hand, the enemy's likely manoeuvres (landing far from the town, the Mahury islet, the Cabassou creek), fire precautions in a wooden town, a retrenchment on the port side and the retreat of the garrison, resistance to the last and then in the country after the project of 1762; orders asked of the minister.

reading_review.by: Claude Opus 5.5 agents for Brice Dudout
reading_review.note: Read word by word as French sentences of 1779 (three agents, one part each, same rules, merged and recounted by script); the cipher words construe with the clear passages and the underlined headings repeat the ciphered summary; but 246 words are restored and 51 unresolved, so 88.8%: grade B, read in part. AI agents only; no human read the reading; not re-checked on the images.

outcome.notes: New partial decipherment: no decipherment of the time and no edition known. Key K-Guy1780c (key.tsv, CC BY 4.0) proposed by Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic) in one API run and frozen; the held-out validation, the word-by-word reading and the write-up are ours.
